instruction: Write an XDP program that must rewrite IP ECN codepoint to CE 0x03 and update L3 header checksum incrementally. Forward all packets with XDP_PASS.
requirements: Verify Ethernet and IPv4 header bounds against data_end
Set lowest 2 bits of ip->tos to 0x03: (ip->tos & 0xFC) | 0x03
Recalculate IPv4 header checksum ip->check over all 20 bytes
SEC("xdp") entry point and GPL license declaration

tests.name: pass_ecn_marked
tests.description: ECN marked with CE and passed

tests.name: pass_arp
tests.description: Non-IP ARP frame passed without alteration
